GhiDanh.menuSelect (GhiDanh.java:19,37,44) is a mutable instance field on a shared Npc singleton overwritten by concurrent players in map 129.
Calick.changeMap() (Calick.java:25-39) mutates this.mapId, this.cx, this.cy, this.map and calls map.npcs.remove/add without synchronization.

db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Called directly from NPC menu handlers (VDST reward, free VDST ticket, buy water bottle); if synchronous JDBC, blocks game/Netty thread.

findings.impact: Players can craft Cuon sach cu / Sach tuyet ky without having required materials (or trigger NPE in getIndexBag/subQuantityItemsBag), and receive items even with a full bag.
findings.root_cause: DONG_THANH_SACH_CU and DOI_SACH_TUYET_KY confirm handlers do not re-validate item non-null/quantities (>=9999, >=1, >=10) or empty bag slots before adding reward items and subtracting materials.
findings.title: Missing material/bag re-validation in BaHatMit book crafting confirmMenu

findings.impact: Players can craft event rewards (item 1220, Hop qua thuong/VIP, Van bay, Cai trang) without owning materials, drive player.inventory.gold negative, or cause NPEs.
findings.root_cause: Confirm menu handlers in CayThong (MENU_DOI_VPSK) and HungVuong (MENU_SINHLE, MENU_SINHLE_XIN, MENU_SINHLE_BANH_DAY, MENU_SINHLE_BANH_CHUNG) do not re-check item non-null/quantities, gold >= cost, subGemAndRuby return value, or empty bag space.
findings.title: Missing material/currency/bag validation in CayThong and HungVuong confirm handlers

findings.impact: Players can drive gold negative when cooking Banh Chung/Banh Tet in NoiBanh1, and craft Banh Chung using only half the required ingredients.
findings.root_cause: NoiBanh1 checks >= 20 for Thit/Nep/Dauxanh/Ladong (line 138) but subtracts only 10 (lines 145-148); neither menu checks player.inventory.gold >= 5_000_000 before executing gold -= 5000000 (lines 152, 179).
findings.title: NoiBanh1 deducts wrong ingredient quantity and allows negative gold

findings.impact: CayThong NPC menu in maps 0, 7, 14 is broken and immediately replaced by the map 184 exit menu.
findings.root_cause: Switch cases 0, 7, 14 in CayThong.openBaseMenu are missing a break statement and fall through into case 184, overwriting the menu with 'Quay ve / Dong'.
findings.title: CayThong.openBaseMenu missing break falls through to map 184 menu

findings.impact: Potential client stream desync on combine/craft animation (-81) when 3 or 5 bag indices are written after count byte 2.
findings.root_cause: Message(-81) writes subcommand 1 and item count byte 2, but then writes 5 bag indices in CayThong and 3 bag indices in HungVuong.
findings.title: Message -81 item count mismatch in CayThong and HungVuong

findings.impact: Players can interact with and confirm menus for almost any NPC from anywhere in the map without being near them.
findings.root_cause: canOpenNpc checks (Util.getDistance(...) <= 60 || !MapService.gI().isMapBlackBallWar(mapId)), which bypasses the 60-unit distance check on every non-BlackBallWar map.
findings.title: Npc.canOpenNpc bypasses distance check on all non-BlackBallWar maps

findings.impact: BaHatMit case 7 leaves client bag UI out of sync after consuming item 1211; case 6 duplicates case 7 logic when only 1211 is in bag.
findings.root_cause: In case 7, sendItemBags(player) is called at line 562 before subQuantityItemsBag(player, item, 1) at line 563. In case 6, sendItemBags is not called after subQuantityItemsBag.
findings.title: BaHatMit snowman turn-in calls sendItemBags before subtracting item

findings.impact: Same-day clan members (0 days in clan) can enter Doanh Trai and Khi Gas Huy Diet despite the 1-day requirement message.
findings.root_cause: Both check getNumDateFromJoinTimeToToday() < 0 instead of < 1 while displaying 'Gia nhap bang hoi tren 1 ngay moi duoc tham gia'.
findings.title: Off-by-one clan join day check in LinhCanh and MrPoPo

findings.impact: Race condition on Calick map/npcs list and GhiDanh.menuSelect under concurrent player interactions.
findings.root_cause: Calick.changeMap mutates shared map.npcs and coordinates without synchronization; GhiDanh stores per-player menuSelect array in a shared Npc instance field.
findings.title: Unsynchronized shared state in Calick and GhiDanh NPCs

findings.impact: Players who have completed TASK_34_0 cannot teleport to map 155 via Osin in map 154.
findings.root_cause: In mapId 154 case 0, only the branch TaskService.gI().getIdTask(player) < ConstTask.TASK_34_0 has code; there is no else branch for >= TASK_34_0.
findings.title: Osin map 154 missing teleport logic when task >= TASK_34_0

findings.impact: Potential NullPointerException if WorldMartialArtsTournamentManager.gI().chatText is null before loop header executes.
findings.root_cause: For-loop condition calls chatText.size() before checking chatText != null inside the loop body.
findings.title: Null check placed after .size() in NonInteractiveNPC.update

key_classes.name: NonInteractiveNPC

key_classes.name: BaHatMit

key_classes.name: GhiDanh
key_classes.responsibility: Handles tournament registration and rewards for WorldMartialArtsTournament (map 52) and DHVT23 (map 129).

key_classes.name: QuyLaoKame
key_classes.responsibility: Handles skill shop, clan area teleport/disband, TreasureUnderSea (BDKB) dungeon entry, and event turn-in.

key_classes.name: Osin
key_classes.responsibility: Handles Kaio/Bill/Prison planet travel, MajinBuu event entry, and Mabu tower floor progression/buffs.

module_summary: Read all 50 files in the NPC subsystem (NonInteractiveNPC, Npc base class, and 48 npc_list classes). Npc extends/implements menu creation (opcode 32), NPC chat (opcode 124), and distance/map checks via canOpenNpc. Individual NPCs in npc_list route player menu selections to CombineService, ShopService, ChangeMapService, TaskService, InventoryService, and pho ban / tournament services. Three NPCs (ChiChi, DuongTang, NgoKhong) are completely commented out, and OngGohan's old VND/Giftcode logic is commented out.

short tempId, UTF text (NPC chat bubble)
Combine/craft animation packets: sub 0 (short tempId), sub 1 (byte count, byte[] bagIndices), sub 7/8 (short iconIDs)
